about_short_description.short_description: Pyrls is a drug summaries resource for learning and managing therapy points and clinical pearls about more than 500 leading medicines.

product.name: Drug Summaries
product.description: Provides concise, practical information on over 800 medications including pharmacology, indications, warnings, and proper use.

product.name: Pharmacotherapy Reviews
product.description: Offers guideline-based reviews and charts for managing pharmacotherapy of major disease states.

product.name: Knowledge Check Assessments
product.description: Weekly quizzes to test and improve knowledge on foundational and advanced pharmacotherapy topics.

product.name: Drug-Drug Interactions Tools
product.description: A tool to quickly review and assess drug-drug interactions with detailed explanations of interaction mechanisms.

product.name: Pyrls Browser Extension
product.description: A browser extension that displays clinical pearls and a customizable dashboard on the new tab screen.
